verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no mention of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or any other RAG or agent framework integration. The documented integrations are embedding providers (OpenAI, OpenCLIP, VoyageAI) and Hugging Face dataset scanning, plus a first-party RAG tutorial and a coding-agent plugin. None of these show a maintained first-class connector to RAG or agent frameworks, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.
